clips.title: The story
paras: Waterspring Field is a vital water-pumping operation in northern Tanaris, constructed by the goblins of Gadgetzan to tap underground aquifers. Instead of supplying the boomtown, the field has been overtaken by the ruthless Wastewander bandits, who now hoard the desert's most precious resource.

In the searing wastes of Tanaris, nothing carries more value than fresh water. Seeking to support their expanding trade hub, the Steamwheedle Cartel goblins of Gadgetzan erected an array of industrial pumping towers across Waterspring Field to draw from underground reserves. Their plans collapsed when the Wastewanders—a sprawling band of human outlaws and desert marauders—seized the entire field. The bandits now guard the hijacked pumps with their lives, forcing Gadgetzan to look for hired blades willing to reclaim the moisture.
